Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire/aim in that direction and set facing; movement and firing combine in one action; 'wait' delays; pointer only hovers UI. Bombs are placed via the bomb button (count decrements) and explode after a short fuse.

MECHANICS (observed): Enemy/projectile/green-cloud/black-teardrop contact damages player; HUD shows hearts (hollow when lost) plus coin/key/bomb counters. Pickups increment counters on touch (confirmed: floor coin disk -> coin 01 then 02; fuse-lit hovering bomb sprite -> bombs +1, harmless to touch; gilded mound destroyed by downward lasers dropped a coin). Rocks, TNT barrels, locked chests, poop, braziers block movement/tears; gilded poop/mound is destructible and drops an item (coins observed). Locked chests need keys. TNT barrels are inert to tears but chain-detonate near bomb blasts. Bombs are effective room-clearers (killed fat enemies efficiently); step ~2 tiles away before detonation. TECH X = radial ring/laser tears (~1.5-tile radius, short range, wide arc); bursts/chars render only briefly, so screenshots often miss them; ring origin/red crack overlay locates hits. Red crack/X overlay = object or enemy being damaged (not a hazard); the red crack 'ring' follows a Tech X tear in flight.

PLAYER SPRITE (observed, important): appearance alternates wildly and can mislead (white round face, monitor/TV face, striped egg, shield face, hatched face, old bald figure, golden/red damage flash) and is sometimes invisible for frames; confirm identity by moving and seeing which sprite responds. Enemies never show the screen/TV face. One 'enemy' mistaken for hostile was the player; conversely, gray round blobs staying perfectly still across frames were static rocks, not enemies—track whether a sprite actually moves.

ENEMIES: gray winged flies; fat pink/white-faced enemies (tanky, flash red near death, enrage skull/dark-mouth, chase, fire black teardrop columns; point-blank contact repeatedly drained hearts; die efficiently to bombs); knife-topped white-faced enemies; shelled white-faced round enemies (spawn in rock ring, emerge exposed, smoke puff when hit, enrage, emit green orbs, die leaving damaging green cloud); blue orbs/droplets and blue spiders chase; cup/goo spawners emit orbs; fire-skull; hooded blobs; small dark enemies can appear after damaging larger ones; a green blob once dissipated harmlessly.

DOOR RULES (hypothesis, repeatedly observed): doors fail to transition until enemies are cleared; transitions need near-exact centering on the door and often several presses while centered; backing off and re-approaching helps; off-center presses fail even 10-20px from center. Alcove/hatch-style openings behave the same as tall doors.

NAVIGATION (observed chain): Tutorial room (MOVE/ATTACK/BOMB/ITEM wall diagrams; top door, bottom door, dark right-wall panel with red dots—inert to presses) <-> bottom door -> brazier room (four lit corner braziers, central rock ring containing a locked chest, poop pile left of ring, golden gate bottom center, top alcove back to tutorial) <-> bottom gate -> item room (pedestal TECH X; top gold-trimmed door back to brazier room). Tutorial top door -> rock room (scattered rocks, left gold keyhole door inert without key, top and bottom doors; shelled white-faced enemy plus a hovering worm/hoop enemy spawn here) -> top: TNT room (barrel column along left wall sheltering two gray locked chests, two center-right barrels, bomb pickup floating, top and bottom doors; hatch marks on bottom wall) -> top: fat-enemy room (rocky right side with stones and green sprouts, gray altar/ornament on left wall holding a gold item—inert to touch, appears to be a locked gate not a pickup; a gilded mound among right rocks destructible into coins; two fat/knife enemies chase; black teardrops fall; minimap skull icons above). Minimap top-right highlights current room; icon meanings still guesses.

FAILED STRATEGIES: fighting fat/knife enemies at point-blank or lingering when boxed in repeatedly cost hearts; firing through central rocks wasted shots; waiting on the fuse-lit bomb sprite did nothing; pressing the left gold keyhole door or left wall ornament without a key never opens it; tutorial right-wall red-dot panel never opened; lingering in green clouds or black teardrop lanes drains hearts fast; guessing player identity from sprite look wasted turns.

ACTIVE GOALS: obtain the golden key (keys stayed 00 throughout; key suspected to be on/near the left wall ornament or an uncollected altar item—pickup unconfirmed) to open locked chests in TNT room or the brazier-room chest; survive/clear the fat-enemy room to see whether a door opens.

UNRESOLVED: whether doors unlock only on full clear; whether the left wall ornament/gold item in the fat-enemy room is a purchasable/collectible item or a locked gate (touching it gave no key); where the golden key actually is; meanings of minimap icons (key and skull); whether gilded poop beyond coins can drop keys; why all hearts showed hollow while the player still acted twice (revive/extra-life state or delayed death—one episode ended in death, so hollow-heart state is ambiguous); whether green orbs damage or can be absorbed; whether rock-room keyhole opens with the golden key; whether the wall skull carving fires hazards; whether the tutorial right-wall panel is a door.
